name: report-reads
note: Read-only probe of standard TDL report names via EXPORT/TYPE:DATA (finding #23-#27). One request per report; only the <ID> differs from request-template.xml. Issued by an ad-hoc scratchpad script, so 'script' is null. Responses are the four financial reports whose figures the reconciliation in #23 ties out against. Error-shape responses (unknown report, bad company, malformed XML) are quoted verbatim in FINDINGS.md #25 rather than stored, being one line each.
